title: 고속버스 터미널: 표를 사고, 탈 때 뭘 해요?
objective: Buy a bus ticket, ask where to board, and use -을 때 / -ㄹ 때.
summary: Buy an express bus ticket and follow boarding instructions.
setting: The ticket counter at an express bus terminal. A customer is buying a one-person ticket to Busan.

task.title: Use the terminal expressions
task.line: Read each item, then write or choose the Korean that fits the bus terminal situation.

words.exampleMeaning: The ticket counter is on the first floor.
I sat in a window seat and looked outside.
I have long legs, so I prefer the aisle side.

words.meaning: boarding platform, gate (where you get on)
words.exampleMeaning: Look carefully at the platform number.
I ate udon at the rest area.

words.meaning: when (doing) …. Vowel stem + ㄹ 때 (사다 → 살 때). Consonant stem + 을 때 (먹다 → 먹을 때). Stem ending in ㄹ: just add 때 (열다 → 열 때).
words.exampleMeaning: When I buy a ticket, I pay by card.

dialogue.korean: 저기요, 부산 가는 표 한 장 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Excuse me, one ticket to Busan, please.
There's a premium bus at 2:30. Would you like a window seat?

dialogue.korean: 네, 창가로 주세요. 그런데 버스는 어디에서 타요?
dialogue.meaning: Yes, a window seat, please. By the way, where do I get on the bus?

dialogue.korean: 7번 타는 곳에서 타세요. 탈 때 기사님께 이 표를 보여 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Board at platform 7. When you get on, show this ticket to the driver.
Does it stop at a rest area on the way?

dialogue.korean: 네, 한 번 서요. 휴게소에서 내릴 때 버스 번호를 꼭 확인하세요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, it stops once. When you get off at the rest area, be sure to check the bus number.

exercises: Change the verb in brackets to the -을 때 / -ㄹ 때 form: ① 버스에서 (내리다) ____ 짐을 꼭 챙기세요. ② 자리를 (찾다) ____ 표에 있는 자리 번호를 보세요. ③ 무거운 가방을 (들다) ____ 조심하세요.
Choose the right place (매표소 / 휴게소 / 타는 곳): ① 여기에서 표를 사요. ② 버스가 가는 길에 잠깐 서요. 화장실에 가고 간식을 사요.
Fill in the blank to ask for the seat you want: ① You like to look outside. → ____ 자리로 주세요. ② You need to go to the toilet often. → ____ 자리로 주세요.
Answer in Korean: You are at the terminal and want to take the bus to Daegu. Ask a staff member where to get on the bus.
answers: ① 내릴 때 ② 찾을 때 ③ 들 때
① 창가 (또는: 창가 쪽) ② 통로 쪽 (또는: 통로)
대구 가는 버스 타는 곳이 어디예요? (또는: 대구 가는 버스는 어디에서 타요?)
